persona: Fictional Northriver Lab handbook. Not a real person or conversation.

items.content: The Northriver Lab preferred tea is jasmine green tea.
The Northriver weekly standup is Tuesday at 10:15 in room B-12.
The synthetic project code name is Cedar Compass.
The faculty advisor of record for this synthetic persona is Professor I. N. Vitro.
The local experiment harness for this project is written in Python.
The Northriver GPU evaluation budget cap recorded in the lab handbook is 75 US dollars for the semester.
Northriver operators prefer a 24 GB GPU for ordinary evaluation sessions.
Northriver lab handbook, beverages: keep a tin of jasmine green tea next to the kettle. Do not assume visitors drink coffee.
Northriver lab handbook, calendar: standup remains Tuesday 10:15, room B-12, unless the room sheet is updated in writing.
Northriver lab handbook, naming: the Cedar Compass code name is internal and synthetic. It is not a deployed product name.
Northriver lab handbook, memory: store durable facts and source passages together. A fact is a short attested statement. A source passage is the supporting excerpt.
Northriver lab handbook, compute: prefer 24 GB cards for ordinary runs; 48 GB only for a planned larger-model condition. Record session spend separately from token-price estimates.
